answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 47980 Country: PAKISTAN Title: Tution Fee to teach The Quran Question: Kindly clear me in details that weather it is haram or halal to charge fee against teaching of the holy Quran, because I have one good offer right now. What should I do now? Answer ID: 47980 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1261/1261/M=11/1434) The later scholars have declared it lawful to take fees on the teaching of the holy Quran in case of need; hence you may receive fees. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
